actions.label: Restart workloads
actions.description: Restart the Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet behind a problem.
actions.effect: May set the restartedAt annotation on the affected workload, like kubectl rollout restart.

actions.label: Argo CD: sync
actions.description: Sync an app that is out of sync.
actions.effect: May start a sync of the affected Argo CD app (a patch of its operation field).

actions.label: Argo CD: hard refresh
actions.description: Re-read an app's state from Git.
actions.effect: May set the annotation argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard on the affected app.

actions.label: Argo CD: roll back
actions.description: Take a manual-sync app back to a state it was deployed in before, also without a problem.
actions.effect: May start a sync of a manual-sync app to a revision from its own history (same source, a patch of its operation field). Only with actions.enabled in the Helm chart.

actions.label: CloudNativePG: backup
actions.description: Start an overdue backup right away.
actions.effect: May create one Backup object for the affected database cluster.

actions.label: Longhorn: backup
actions.description: Take a snapshot and a backup of a volume whose backup is too old, right away.
actions.effect: May create a Longhorn snapshot and a backup object for the volume concerned.

actions.label: Velero: backup
actions.description: Start a backup from a schedule's template right away.
actions.effect: May read the schedule and create a backup object from it, like velero backup create --from-schedule.

actions.label: Reconcile now
actions.description: Ask Flux, External Secrets, Infisical or cert-manager to reconcile an object with a problem right away.
actions.effect: May set an annotation on the object concerned (Flux requestedAt, External Secrets force-sync, Infisical) or have a certificate renewed like cmctl renew.

actions.label: Uncordon nodes
actions.description: Open a node that has been cordoned for a long time without a reason to new pods again.
actions.effect: May set spec.unschedulable to false on the node concerned, like kubectl uncordon. Nothing else on nodes.

actions.label: Clean up finished pods
actions.description: Delete the failed and evicted pods of a namespace. Never running ones.
actions.effect: May delete pods that have finished (Failed, or Succeeded without a Job). The admission policy allows nothing else.

actions.label: Run jobs again
actions.description: Start a failed job again: from the CronJob's template, or as a copy of a stand-alone job.
actions.effect: May create Jobs (like kubectl create job --from=cronjob/…). Only with actions.enabled in the Helm chart.

actions.label: Remove stuck pods
actions.description: Delete a pod stuck in Terminating on a failed node right away.
actions.effect: May remove pods that are already being deleted, without waiting. Only with actions.enabled in the Helm chart.

actions.label: Argo CD: stop sync
actions.description: End a sync that has been running for more than 30 minutes.
actions.effect: May set status.operationState.phase to Terminating on the app concerned, like argocd app terminate-op. Only with actions.enabled in the Helm chart.

actions.label: Grow volumes
actions.description: Grow a volume that is almost full by a quarter, when its StorageClass allows it.
actions.effect: May raise the requested size of the PVC concerned (by half at most). Only with actions.enabled in the Helm chart.

actions.label: Spot changed ConfigMaps
actions.description: For a crashing pod, check whether a ConfigMap of its environment changed after its start, and then offer the restart as the fix.
actions.effect: May read ConfigMaps across the cluster (get). Kubernanny asks only for their metadata, but the permission reaches their contents. Only with actions.enabled in the Helm chart.

actions.label: Read logs
actions.description: Show the last lines of a crashed pod.
actions.effect: Only reads the last 300 lines of the pod an issue names; changes nothing.
